problem.name: Euclidean closest pair
problem.statement_latex: Given $n$ points in $\mathbb Q^d$ with finite word-sized coordinates and fixed dimension $d$, output two distinct points of minimum Euclidean distance. Complexity counts coordinate queries and RAM operations.
problem.statement_text: Given $n$ points in $\mathbb Q^d$ with finite word-sized coordinates and fixed dimension $d$, output two distinct points of minimum Euclidean distance. Complexity counts coordinate queries and RAM operations.
